shots.name: machines
shots.eval: /* Invoke the mockup's own go() through its stable navigation control. */ document.querySelector('button[data-go="machines"]').click()

shots.name: long-session
shots.eval: /* Open the long transcript through the session list's goSession() click handler. */ document.querySelector('button[data-go="sessions"]').click(); document.querySelector('.nrow[data-id="harbor"]').click()

shots.name: child-session
shots.eval: /* Open harbor, then its h2 handoff calls goSession() for the child run. */ document.querySelector('button[data-go="sessions"]').click(); document.querySelector('.nrow[data-id="harbor"]').click(); document.querySelector('.hcard[data-h="h2"]').click()
